rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a language’s grammar or rules about correct usage.

example.english: English grammar is really quite difficult.
example.jyutping: jing1 man4 man4 faat3 zan1 hai6 gei2 naan4

rows.note: Use this more formal term when discussing the grammatical structure or syntax of a language.

example.english: This paper gives a detailed analysis of Cantonese grammar.
example.traditional: 呢篇論文詳細分析咗粵語嘅語法。
example.jyutping: nei1 pin1 leon6 man4 coeng4 sai3 fan1 sik1 zo2 jyut6 jyu5 ge3 jyu5 faat3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a book that explains a language’s grammar.

example.english: I bought an English grammar book to study from.
example.traditional: 我買咗本英文文法書嚟溫書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bun2 jing1 man4 man4 faat3 syu1 lai4 wan1 syu1
